question.text: The Himalaya Arbitrage Fund (Cat III AIF) has a subscription list with 10 investors. Their commitments (in INR crore) are: 1.0, 1.2, 0.8, 1.5, 0.3 (manager's employee), 2.0 (accredited investor), 0.9, 1.0, 0.25 (manager's employee), 1.1. How many investors BREACH the minimum-investment rule?

explanation.text: The Logic: Rules: INR 1 crore minimum investor commitment; INR 25 lakh exception for employees/directors of the manager; accredited investors are exempt from the minimum. Check: 1.0 OK; 1.2 OK; 0.8 FAIL (sub-1 cr, not employee/AI); 1.5 OK; 0.3 employee (>=25 lakh) OK; 2.0 AI exempt OK; 0.9 FAIL (sub-1 cr, not employee/AI); 1.0 OK; 0.25 employee (==25 lakh) OK; 1.1 OK. Two breaches (0.8 and 0.9). The Trap: Trap 1: forgetting that employees have an INR 25 lakh relaxation flags 0.3 and 0.25 as fails (wrong). Trap 2: flagging 2.0 AI as a breach (wrong — AIs are exempt). Correct count is 2. Note: The workbook (p. 105) sets the INR 1 crore investor minimum, the INR 25 lakh employee/director exception, and the accredited-investor exemption.
